share: Menu item: makes this private chat a room (a chat other people join). "Room" is a product noun.
section: Label of the chat's items in the phone header's ⋯ menu.
title-input: Accessible name of the text box that renames a chat in place.
chat-options: Accessible name of the ⋯ button beside the chat's title in the header.
room-options: Accessible name of the ⋯ button beside a room's title in the header. "Room" is a product noun (a chat several people share).
new-chat: Menu item that starts a new chat with this socio (AI agent), and the last breadcrumb in the header on the page of a chat not started yet.
undo: Button in the toast after archiving; it puts the chat or socio back.
blocked.running: Each blocked.* key: Tooltip on the disabled Delete item, and the confirm's text, saying what stops the chat from being deleted now. "Socio" is an AI agent; "page" is a document in a Space.
delete-dialog.title: Title of the confirm before deleting a chat for good.
delete-dialog.body: The confirm's text; {{title}} is the chat's title. Keep the quotation marks your language uses.
delete-dialog.body-tasks: The confirm's text for a chat with scheduled tasks (tasks a socio runs on a schedule in it), which go with it; {{title}} is the chat's title.
toasts.deleted: Toast after a chat was deleted; {{title}} is its title.
dot-crumb.switch: Accessible name of the header breadcrumb that opens a menu of this socio's chats; {{name}} is the socio's name.
dot-crumb.chats-with: Heading of that menu; {{name}} is the socio's name.
dot-crumb.all: Menu item that opens the socio's home page, listing all its chats.
dot.name-input: Accessible name of the text box that renames a socio (AI agent) in place.
dot.allowed: Heading over the socio's permissions in its menu (the checkboxes below).
dot.research: Checkbox: the socio may read public web pages to research.
dot.memory: Checkbox: the socio may use what it remembers about people.
dot.issues: Checkbox (admins): the socio may file issues on the Improvements board, the workspace's list of feature requests.
dot.activity: Menu item (admins) that opens the audit of what the socio did.
dot.soul: Menu item that opens the socio's Soul: its character and instructions. "Soul" is a product noun.
dot.archive: Menu item; it asks first (the ellipsis says a dialog follows).
dot.settings: Menu item that opens every setting of the socio in a dialog.
dot.archived: Toast after a socio was archived; {{name}} is its name.
dot.archive-dialog.title: Title of the confirm before archiving a socio; {{name}} is its name.
dot.archive-dialog.body: Filings are the issues the socio filed on the board; schedules and goals are its scheduled tasks and objectives.
archived-notice.socio: Banner over a chat whose socio (AI agent) is archived; next to an Unarchive button for its owner.
archived-notice.chat: Banner over an archived chat, next to an Unarchive button.
archived-notice.unarchive-failed: Toast when unarchiving a socio failed without a reason from the server.
